inputs.text: Phoenix’s city council voted Wednesday night to bar ICE and other law enforcement agencies from using city property. This is not protecting families; it’s putting political posturing ahead of public safety and respect for the law. When local officials obstruct cooperation with authorities, they weaken the institutions communities depend on and deepen distrust. Ordinary residents deserve leaders who uphold order, not make law enforcement’s job harder.
